bridge.title: Where GENESIS fits
bridge.intro: Your team sets the target and makes the decisions. Your CAD tools run the simulations. GENESIS does the work in between.

modules.title: What GENESIS does
modules.intro: GENESIS runs on your own Linux server, next to your Cadence tools and licenses. Your engineers use it in the browser.

items.title: Passive synthesis
items.detail: Pixel layouts for baluns, dividers, couplers, filters and other N-port structures, each checked with your EM solver.

items.title: Optimization
items.detail: Evolutionary, Bayesian and reinforcement-learning search, parallel simulations, Pareto trade-offs and GDS export.

items.title: Active circuits
items.detail: Your Cadence schematics with Spectre S-parameter, noise, harmonic-balance and stability analyses, tuned toward your targets.

items.title: Composer
items.detail: Active stages and passive structures on one canvas, exported to Cadence as a library with testbenches.

items.title: Design assistant
items.detail: Describe the design; the assistant sets up the right tool and can run the optimization for you.

items.title: Results and scripting
items.detail: Every run keeps its settings, responses and GDS files. The same steps also run from Python.

story.headline: Why we’re building GENESIS.
story.intro: We bring together RFIC research and experience in building AI products. Our shared aim is to connect the parts of the design process that too often happen in isolation.
paragraphs: Changing a circuit is only one part of the job. Engineers also need to prepare the next simulation, compare it with earlier runs and check what the change means for the physical design.

We are building GENESIS so that this process does not need to be reconstructed with every iteration. Engineers should be able to focus on the circuit, and carry the settings and results of earlier work into their next design.

loop.caption: Your design team, GENESIS and your CAD tools in one design loop.

steps.title: Your team sets the target
steps.detail: Band, gain, noise figure and matching for the circuit you need.

steps.title: GENESIS prepares the design
steps.detail: It sizes the devices and synthesizes the matching networks for your topology.

steps.title: Your CAD tools simulate it
steps.detail: Circuit simulation for the devices, EM simulation for the passives.

steps.title: GENESIS compares and refines
steps.detail: It checks every result against the target and prepares the next iteration.

steps.title: You review and decide
steps.detail: The best design and its results come back to you for layout and verification.
